support_claim: The packet links NBA-102 to Northbridge Analytics and billing to Northbridge Analytics Inc. via compatible naming, but explicitly records unresolved registry identity and provides no establishing identity or distinctness evidence for this pair.

steps.fact: The candidate pair is crm:NBA-102 (left) and billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. (right) under relation identity_judgment.
CRM row NBA-102 lists the customer name as Northbridge Analytics.
Billing invoices use billed_name Northbridge Analytics Inc.
Commercial notes state sales uses the short name Northbridge Analytics while billing and the MSA use Northbridge Analytics Inc.

Commercial notes report a 2024 credit check returned a Wyoming LLC named Northbridge Analytics LLC and state that Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party; the registry link must be treated as unresolved.

No packet excerpt supplies a shared legal identifier or other establishing identity evidence linking NBA-102 to the billing billed_name Northbridge Analytics Inc.; name similarity and naming compatibility alone do not meet the SAME_ENTITY burden.

No packet excerpt establishes that crm:NBA-102 and billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. are distinct entities; unresolved registry identity and absence of identity proof do not satisfy the DISTINCT burden.
